hooks.text: Over half of the famous Bronze Age destructions never actually happened.
Why did nearly every great civilization collapse within a few decades?
The greatest catastrophe of the ancient world was largely a modern myth.

title: Why the Bronze Age Collapse Was a Myth 😳
description: Around 1177 BC, the eastern Mediterranean faced dramatic upheaval, but modern research reveals many destruction layers were misdated.
